stage_1_feature_thresholds.details: Thresholds are fixed numerical constants (10 uV) applied uniformly without fitting to any participant data.

stage_2_normalization_scaler.details: Per-fold z-score parameters (mu, sd) are computed strictly on outer training participants (R_{-p}) and applied transform-only to test participant p.

stage_3_inner_cross_fitted_shap.details: Held-out test participant p is masked out before inner GroupKFold splits. Attribution is computed out-of-fold across inner training subjects only.

stage_4_channel_ranking_selection.details: Channel ranking R_{-p} is derived strictly from outer-training subjects. Participant p's data is never seen during ranking.

stage_5_lambda_regularization.details: Lambda = 0.50 was pre-specified in frozen_analysis_plan.yaml on 2026-08-12, not tuned on test fold performance.

stage_6_model_retraining.details: Classifier is trained from scratch on top-k selected channels using only outer training data.

stage_7_longitudinal_directionality.details: CS1 trains exclusively on Session 1 and evaluates on Sessions 1, 2, 3. CS2 trains on Sessions 1+2 and evaluates on Session 3.

stage_8_statistical_unit_participant.details: Statistical unit is strictly the participant (N=43 on GRABMyo, N=10 on NinaPro DB5), preserving within-subject correlation.
